title: Nine Winters and One Short Mirror
subtitle: 情感表达 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感表达（人与自我·做人与做事）
meta: 主题语境：情感表达（人与自我·做人与做事）　|　核心词汇：face　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 face 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1947 my grandmother ① kept a face that no visitor in the hall would have read, and she said the keeping was the whole of the winter. The ② face, meaning the look itself and not the word, ran nine winters and stayed unread in the book; a face, she said, is the only thing in a hall that is judged by how long it is left unread.

Every ③ face in that hall had the same short mirror beside it, and the ④ face at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the photograph and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A face, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to read; my grandmother said the reading is the part that fills nine winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the face was the whole of the cliff, meaning the surface and not the look. The ⑥ face, meaning the surface and not any of that, is the only thing in a cliff that everybody waits for and nobody reads; face, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a look and a surface. He said the surface is the part they remember.

By 1954 the ⑦ face had become a line in a drawing, and the drawing had become an argument about the short mirror. The ⑧ face of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one hall and nine winters of reading; face, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to read. She said the reading was never mentioned.

The ⑨ face I remember is the one read in the drawing, which closed in 1957 and is still described as the quietest in the hall. A ⑩ face, my mother said in 1959, is the only one that improves by being read; every face, she said, is a surface that has agreed to look like a look. She said the surface was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 脸；面部表情（指厅里每一张旁边的那一张）
B. n. 表情（指那副样子本身，与言辞相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep a face 保持一副表情
D. n. 表情（指留给照片的那一副）
E. n. 表情（抽象总称，指一座厅里的脸色之事）
F. n. 表情（指画上写到、被读出的那一副）
G. n. 表面；立面（指一面崖壁上人人都等却无人读出的那样东西）
H. n. 表面（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人读出的那样东西）

items.q: kept a face that no visitor in the hall would have read
The face, meaning the look itself and not the word
the face at the far side
the face was the whole of the cliff
the face had become a line in a drawing
The face of the whole thing
A face, my mother said in 1959

answers.why: keep a face 意为“保持一副表情”，1947 年祖母保持着一副厅里没有一位来客肯读懂的表情。
face 意为“表情”，指那副样子本身而不是言辞，它经过了九个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
face 意为“脸、表情”，指厅里每一张旁边的那一张，每一张旁边都有同一面短短的镜子。
face 意为“表情”，指留给照片的那一副，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
face 意为“表面、立面”，指一面崖壁上人人都等却无人读出的那样东西，叔叔说这面崖壁就是那道崖的全部。
face 意为“表面”，指人人都等却无人读出的那样东西而不是那副表情，是崖上人人都等、却无人读出的东西。
face 意为“表情”，指画上写到、被读出的那一副，到 1954 年这一副成了画里的一行。
face 意为“表情”，祖母一月写道，整件事的脸色之事是一座厅和九个冬天的读出。
face 意为“表情”，我记得的是画上读出的那一副，1957 年结束了，至今仍被说成厅里最安静的一副。
face 为抽象总称，母亲 1959 年说，一副表情是唯一会因为被好好读出而变得更好的东西。
